name: MEPDrawingSetup
description: Once per project, before the first MEP drawing: everything drawing production needs (the DrawingProductionSetup workflow — shared parameters, title blocks, tag families, styles, view templates, AEC filters, view types, pre-flight), then the MEP system types and system filters the MEP style packs colour by, then the seed families placement and routing use. Every step skips what already exists, so it is safe to run again after a plugin or catalogue update.

steps.label: Drawing production setup (runs WORKFLOW_DrawingProductionSetup: parameters, title blocks, tags, styles, templates, filters, view types, pre-flight)
Create the STING duct and pipe system types (supply, return, exhaust, CHW, LTHW, DCW, DHW, SAN …)
Type, name and stamp the MEP systems already in the model
Create the abbreviation-keyed MEP system filters the style packs colour by
Build the STING seed families (fixtures, equipment, dampers, junction boxes …) placement and routing need

_notes: Run MEPDrawingProduction after modelling and tagging; run MEPPreIssue before every issue.
Choose the sheet-number policy (per drawing type, or ISO 19650) on the Project Setup Wizard's Automation page first; it writes PRJ_ORG_SHEET_NUMBER_POLICY_TXT.
